lines: What if your child's stories became real books?
Coro is a book maker for families. Your photos, your child's drawings, your words, made into a beautiful picture book.
Then read it in your own voice. Every page plays back the way you read it.
Share it with grandparents, cousins and friends, and they can add their voices too.
When it's time to read, choose how it plays: touch a word to hear it, a page at a time, or listen with the lights down at bedtime.
Each child gets their own profile. Parental controls and a grown-up check keep buying, sharing and settings with you.
Need a spark? Ideas has sixty-four kinds of books to make together. And every Book Store book shows exactly how it was made.
Coro. Books you make together.
Want to make your very own book?
Draw anything! Add photos of your pet, your family, your best day ever.
Then read it out loud. Your voice is in the book!
Send it to Grandma and Grandpa. They can read it with you.
Pick your Coro and start making. Coro!
Hi! I'm Coro.
Hi there! I'm Coro. Let's make a book together!
Tap Make a book, and your notebook opens up.
Now draw a picture. Any picture you like! Swirly, spotty, silly... it's all perfect!
Then write what happens. Just a few words is plenty.
Want more? Add another page!
Give your book a name, and put your own name on the cover. You're the author!
Last of all, read it out loud with someone you love, and record it.
Ta-da! Your very own book!
Coro. Books you make together.
Welcome to Coro! Here, you and your child make picture books together.
Make a book in minutes. Draw or add photos, write a few words on each page, and design a cover.
Then read it aloud and record it. Every Coro book you make is told in a real voice: yours, a grandparent's, your child's.
Your books live in My Library, next to Coro books from the Book Store.
Read together, or let a book read itself, with Daydream by day and Nightlight at bedtime.
Share your books with family, wherever they are.
Each reader gets their own profile and shelf.
Buying, sharing and settings ask a grown-up first, so little hands can explore freely.
Coro. Books you make together.
This is Coro.
Make a book with your child: pictures, words, and your own voices.
Keep them all in My Library.
Find new Coro books in the Book Store.
And share them with the people you love.
Coro. Books you make together.
Ready? Tap Make a book.
Start with what your book is about. One idea is all you need.
Draw right on the page, or add a photo of your child's artwork.
Add a few words to each page. Short is sweet.
On the cover, move and style the title and the author's name just how you like.
Tap Finish. Now the best part: read your book aloud and record it, page by page.
Your book is now told in your voice.
Share it with grandparents, cousins, friends. They can listen anywhere.
Coro. Books you make together.
Tap any book on the shelf, and it opens like a real one.
Turn the pages and read together, at your own pace.
Tap a word to hear it.
Pick who reads: the narrator, or anyone in the family who recorded it.
Want to listen? Daydream plays calm pictures by day. Nightlight dims everything for bedtime.
Reading Options let you change the text size, font and more.
Make a playlist, and books play one after another.
Coro. Books you make together.
Kids can see everything in Coro. Buying, sharing and settings just need a grown-up to open them.
A quick question only a grown-up can answer keeps those doors closed.
In Parental Controls, set your child's age, and Coro shows books that fit.
You decide what gets shared, and with whom.
So your child can explore freely, and you can relax.
Coro. Books you make together.
Hello, teachers! Coro has a Classroom mode.
Make a folder for each class, with up to 30 students.
Paste in your class list, and every student gets a profile in one go.
See your class as a grid or a list.
Each student makes and records their own books, on their own shelf.
At the end of the year, select and remove profiles or whole classes in a few taps.
Make books together as a class, and share them with families.
Coro. Books you make together.
